cut_argument: Each pair needs ceil(14/3)=5 blocks. For a point, 15 pair incidences sum to four times its degree; hence ceil(75/4)=19.
scope: Exact models within the 528-block pool only. No symmetry, fixed degree or cap/extension split. No global exclusion or proof claim.
